d: Vishnu, a 17-year-old boy, born via IVF and raised by two women, becomes curious about his biological father. So, he sets out on a journey to find his father and connect with him.
Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.
Shankar, a humble youth from Madikeri, Karnataka, moves to Bengaluru in search of a job. However, his life changes drastically once he becomes an underworld gangster.
